facts.text: Regardless of major, all students at Patrick Henry College take an extensive 63-credit Christian Classical Liberal Arts Core Curriculum that includes logic, rhetoric, philosophy, constitutional law, and foreign language proficiency.

sources.title: Core Curriculum | Patrick Henry College (PHC)
sources.quote: These foundational commitments inspired the formation of PHC's Christian Classical Liberal Arts Core Curriculum, which consists of 63-credits with intermediate proficiency in a foreign language. Every student—regardless of major—takes every Core Curriculum course:
